label: Re-route the cogito/roster GodExists routes through grades to a maximum at being
summary: Issue #1519 part 2. Checked in Lean where the four cogito/roster routes use STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM (6c27657f). 5e8e6054, 1c154f2f and 72391d4d use it only at esse, inside actualCore (via maximumExistsOfNecessaryAt or maximumExistsOfExistingRoot). 0a639ec4 uses it at verum through quartaVia, so it records strong_version_needed. Registered the strength order 6c27657f => e4e6b0cd (gradesAtBeingOfGrades, reusing restrictGrades). Built verified siblings of 72391d4d (directEsseRootGodExistsAtBeing) and 5e8e6054 (existenceOnlyGodExistsAtBeing) in TruthCore.Results.Causality.GradesAtBeingRoutes. They take STMT-GRADES-TO-MAXIMUM-AT-BEING (e4e6b0cd) and otherwise the same premises. The existing maximum lemma is instantiated at the one-point respect type Unit, where the all-respects principle is definitionally the esse instance. Under strict expansion with 376d6a5a removed, root routes to STMT-GOD-EXISTS surviving go from 1/10 to 3/12. The removal of a4d3261a and 3b2d2d46 is unchanged (2/12), since these routes need STMT-NO-COMPONENT-IS-FIRST-BEING. The sibling arguments declare sense bridges for terms whose two senses their premises already carry: GOD via 1ec205ed, MAXIMAL _6 to _1 via the genus premise d9fad785 applied at esse, and the NECESSARY, NONNECESSARY, WELL_FOUNDEDNESS and INTRINSIC pairs via 5c898d24. No premise is discharged.
blocker: The sibling of 1c154f2f (grades at being with the necessity-cause package) checks in Lean, but it is not registered. Its argument would use NECESSARY_2 together with NECESSARY_3 and NECESSARY_4, and NECESSITY_OF_ONE_INDIVIDUAL_VERSUS_NECESSARY _1, _3 and _4. Those passages are the proved lemmas isNecessaryOfNecessaryAt and isNecessaryPerSeOfRoot, not premise statements, so no sense bridge is available. The old argument is legacy-allowlisted. Next test: register those lemmas as premise-free bridge statements (role conclusion), then add the sibling with them as closed premises.
